name: oah-mondego
description: Second, independently-implemented case study: downstream contamination-propagation forecasting for the Mondego River (Coimbra, Portugal), serialized as FHIR R4 RiskAssessment predictions and served over an Express CDS Hooks (v3.0 ballot) service. Proves the FHIR/CDS-Hooks pattern is a portable standard, not a Python-only implementation detail.
